nodes.text: Oh, this is useless. We have no idea where $Oscar went.

nodes.text: Excuse me. Did you two girls say you're looking for a dragon?

nodes.text: It doesn't matter. We're never going to find it anyway.

nodes.text: Not around here, you won't! A dragon would never hang out at the mall! The very idea is preposterous!

nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Of course! As Unnatural Historian of the Centerscore Cryptozoological Society, I know all there is to know about tracking and locating dragons.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Really? You can tell us where to find $Oscar?

nodes.text: Well, sure, I `could`, but you girls should know that I charge 200 coins for my tracking services.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, sure, I [i]could[/i], but you girls should know that I charge 200 coins for my tracking services.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...But we don't have 200 coins.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I know! How much do you charge your friends to help them find a missing dragon?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hm. Well, it's never come up before, but I suppose I'd help my friends out for free.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: In that case, we promise to send you a friend request as soon as we get home!

nodes.text: Yeah! That way we can be friends forever!

nodes.text: A 'friend request'? You mean like on the internet?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Sure! It's just like being real friends only we never have to see you in person, and we can ignore anything you post on our walls.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, I guess I can help you out...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The important thing to remember is that dragons are fiery in nature. That means they can overheat.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: As a consequence, dragons prefer to live near bodies of fresh water so that they can take a dip every now and again to cool off!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Huh. That... That actually makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hope that helps, friends. Now I've got to be on my way.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I've got a solid lead on the location of a North American Painted Grootslang!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte

nodes.text: Did you do it?

nodes.text: Yep. I chained $Oscar to the old coal furnace in the basement. There's no way he can escape again!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Coal?! But doesn't coal burn?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Normally, I guess, but the sign on the furnace door said the contents were '`in`flammable'.

nodes.text: Kay, 'flammable' and 'inflammable' mean the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Kay

nodes.text: Cough... Someone call the fire department!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Someone call the police!

nodes.text: Someone call the local news! If I'm going to live through a horrible disaster, I want it televised!

nodes.text: Mom, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: How many fingers are we holding up?

nodes.text: I'm fine, girls, but I'm also confused. I just don't know how a fire could've started in our basement.

nodes.text: I never said...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! It's not like Kay tied her pet dragon to the coal furnace or anything because that would be...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Dragons? What's this about dragons?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Nothing! Dragons aren't real, right? Kel is just making a really bad joke!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Now's no time for jokes, girls! And it doesn't matter `what` started the fire.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now's no time for jokes, girls! And it doesn't matter [i]what[/i] started the fire.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What matters is we're homeless now. Vagabonds. Drifters. Princes of the Open Road.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Get cracking on your thumb exercises, children, because there's going to be a lot of hitching in your future!

nodes.speaker: Kay

nodes.text: Behind Kay and Kel, the trash can begins to smolder and then erupts into flame!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay, Kel, is that trash can on fire?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Uh oh! Our new dragon must've set the trash on fire with his fire breath!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We need to move quickly!
Kay and Kel grab the trash can and carry it outside.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Fire breath?!
Horace rushes into the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What's going on? Why do I smell smoke?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Are Kay and Kel mixing Molotov juice boxes again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, Dad, a trash can caught on fire.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Oh, well, it doesn't look like there's any permanent damage.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Howard, your mother and I are having Mommy and Daddy Time tonight, so I'm putting you in charge of this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But, dad...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: No 'buts', son. Sometimes a man's just got to take one for the team. Sometimes more than one.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sometimes every other Tuesday for the rest of his natural life.
Cathy calls out to Horace from the master bedroom.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Coming, dear!
Horace sighs like a wounded animal and slinks away. A moment later, Kay and Kel creep inside.
Their faces are singed, and their hair is speckled with ash.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hack... Cough...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Eww... My fingers smell like campfire logs.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you girls figure out what caused the fire?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...Uh, spontaneous combustion?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, that seems... Unlikely. And what'd you mean when you said 'dragon'?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: G'night, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, sweet dreams!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: See you tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I may not know what the twins are up to...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I definitely made the right decision when I paid them to stay away from $ZOE.
Meanwhile...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Let's put $Oscar in the closet tonight, and we'll find someplace better to keep him tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But I already put him in the closet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know what? You guys are impossible. I'm going to brush my teeth, and then I'm going to bed.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ahh! No! You can't go in there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Because our, um, friend is in there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You have a friend over?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought Mom revoked that privilege after she caught you two playing Salem Witch Trials in the neighbor's hot tub.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I still don't see what the big deal was.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, if Agatha sank, she would've proved she didn't hex our lockers.
Steam billows up from beneath the bathroom door.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Besides it was an emergency. Our friend's water heater busted, and she needed to take a hot shower.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, okay. That makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll go ask Mom and Dad if I can use their bathroom. Good night, guys.
As Howard steps away, Kay and Kel grab $Oscar from the bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: $Oscar's fire breath steamed the water in the toilet bowl.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Cool... And also totally icky!
A few moments later, Howard and Horace approach the bathroom...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Now wait just a second. What was this about Kay and Kel having a friend over?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not sure. The bathroom is empty now, and it looks like the twins already went to bed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Should I go find out?
Horace sighs and shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Son, it's time you learned an important lesson about women. If they don't want you to know, it's best not to ask.
Horace saunters back to the master bedroom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh. I may not know what the twins are up to...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I definitely made the right decision when I paid them to stay away from $ZOE.
